CIV.note: The framework was adopted by two regulator networks at a conference held in Abidjan; it is not a Ivorian rule, draft or authority.
Nothing on a government body using AI.
A network framework offered to states as a roadmap is not an Ivorian law or draft.
Nothing on AI in a public sector system.
Nothing on AI built or hosted in Cote d'Ivoire.
Names data protection only as a framework priority; no Ivorian law is stated.
Only cultural digital sovereignty in the networks' framework; no state data rule is stated.
Nothing on the national ID system.
